summary: Frontend-only verification of profit-margin feature in Product Catalog (/products-catalog). Created 3 test products via API (healthy-margin w/ BoM, below-cost w/ negative retail_markup_pct + BoM, manual no-BoM), then loaded the admin UI and validated all data-testids and visual states. All checks passed. Test products cleaned up.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend catalog endpoint is /api/catalog-products (hyphen). Note for future consistency: rest of API uses /api/catalog/{resource}-style paths in some places; consider unifying.

For below-cost product the row shows '(-100%)' which is mathematically correct given price=$21.25, cost=$42.50 (margin/price = -100%). If desired, consider using cost as denominator or capping display for negative margins for clarity.
The manual-price row shows only 'manual price' with no cost indication — acceptable but consider a subtle icon/tooltip for admins to explain that dynamic pricing is disabled.
seed_data_creation: Temporarily created 3 TEST_* catalog products; all deleted at end of test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Product Catalog margin feature verified. Key testids: product-row, product-margin, product-belowcost-badge. Backend endpoint for catalog CRUD is /api/catalog-products (not /catalog/products). Below-cost condition = computed_cost != null && (price - computed_cost) < 0. KPI 'Below cost' counts such rows. To force below-cost via API set retail_markup_pct to a negative number with a BoM in place (price is dynamically recomputed by backend).
verified_scenarios: Healthy margin: green text 'cost $8.50 · $17.00 (67%)' rendered inside data-testid=product-margin
Below cost: red row tint (bg-red-50/60), red BELOW COST badge (data-testid=product-belowcost-badge), red margin text 'cost $42.50 · -$21.25 (-100%)'
Manual (no BoM): shows 'manual price' with no data-testid=product-margin node and no belowcost badge
Below cost KPI on metrics row shows count = 1 when a single below-cost product exists
